DISCOVERY 612, PRESENT: DANIEL A. EDINGTON, ESQ. FOR DEFENDANT/MOVING PARTY, WALGREEN COMPANY. TENTATIVE RULING ADOPTED. DEFENDANT'S MOTION TO COMPEL PLAINTIFF'S VERIFIED RESPONSES TO REQUEST FOR ADMISSIONS, SET ONE, AND VERIFIED RESPONSES TO DEFENDANT'S FORM INTERROGATORIES, SET TWO; TO COMPEL PLAINTIFF'S DEPOSITION IS GRANTED. NO OPPOSITION HAS BEEN FILED. PLAINTIFF'S FAILURE TO RESPOND AND TO APPEAR IN THE CONDITION TO GIVE DEPOSITION TESTIMONY WERE MISUSES OF THE DISCOVERY PROCESS. PLAINTIFF IS ORDERED TO RESPOND WITHIN 15 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THIS ORDER AND TO APPEAR FOR HIS DEPOSITION ON A DATE TO BE NOTICED BY DEFENDANT. SANCTIONS ARE AWARDED AGAINST PLAINTIFF IN THE AMOUNT OF $716.30, TO BE PAID WITHIN 30 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THIS ORDER. ORDER SIGNED IN OPEN COURT. COMM: EVERETT A. HEWLETT
